specs.description: Air-cooled, dual-socket AMD HGX B300 platform with eight GPUs and front I/O. Model reference; select the actual installed configuration separately.
specs.notes: Manufacturer-sourced capabilities, not an installed BOM or measurement. RAM, storage, optional DPUs, active fabric mode, optics and exact PSU FRU remain unselected. This is not AS-8126GS-TNMR or the old NVIDIA-B300-4U placeholder. Front/rear artwork is a reference, not installed-part validation. Each illustrated PSU has paired AC inputs; the current visual power mapper does not validate that topology. Reviewed 2026-10-30.

components.model: EPYC 9005 / 9004 family support; exact processor unselected
components.notes: Dual-socket capability; no specific CPU, core count or configured TDP selected. Source: https://www.supermicro.com/en/support/manuals/product/system/as-8126gs-nb3rt/Content/appendix/system-specifications-as-8126gs-nb3rt.htm

Platform specification: eight GPUs, 288 GB HBM3e each; NVLink 5 with NVSwitch. GPU memory is separate from host RAM. No workload demand is inferred. Source: https://www.supermicro.com/datasheet/datasheet_SuperCluster_B300_Front_IO.pdf

Eight physical OSFP ports, capability up to 800 Gb/s. The product page lists 800GbE and the cluster datasheet permits Ethernet/InfiniBand fabrics. Select the actual protocol and configured link rate before cabling; neither is assumed here. Optics are not implied. Source: https://www.supermicro.com/en/products/system/gpu/8u/as-8126gs-nb3rt

Two 10 GbE interfaces. Capability does not establish a negotiated link or installed cable. Source: https://www.supermicro.com/en/support/manuals/product/system/as-8126gs-nb3rt/Content/appendix/system-specifications-as-8126gs-nb3rt.htm

Management is separate from data LAN. Speed remains unspecified. USB, VGA and mini-DP are not network ports. Source: https://www.supermicro.com/en/support/manuals/product/system/as-8126gs-nb3rt/Content/appendix/system-specifications-as-8126gs-nb3rt.htm

custom.name: Platform and cooling
custom.value:
8U air-cooled HGX B300. Not a liquid-cooled 4U variant.
Source: https://www.supermicro.com/datasheet/datasheet_SuperCluster_B300_Front_IO.pdf

custom.name: Host memory capability
custom.value:
24 ECC DDR5 DIMM slots, up to 6 TB. EPYC 9005: up to 6400 MT/s; EPYC 9004: up to 4800 MT/s. Installed DIMM quantities/capacities remain unknown.
Source: https://www.supermicro.com/en/support/manuals/product/system/as-8126gs-nb3rt/Content/appendix/system-specifications-as-8126gs-nb3rt.htm

custom.name: Storage capacity, not installed drives
custom.value:
Eight front E1.S NVMe bays and two M-key 22110 M.2 NVMe slots. Drives and capacities unselected.
Source: https://www.supermicro.com/en/support/manuals/product/system/as-8126gs-nb3rt/Content/appendix/system-specifications-as-8126gs-nb3rt.htm

custom.name: Optional expansion
custom.value:
Two PCIe 5.0 x16 FHHL slots; up to two dual-port BlueField-3 DPUs. Optional DPUs are not created as installed network endpoints.
Source: https://www.supermicro.com/en/products/system/gpu/8u/as-8126gs-nb3rt

custom.name: Manufacturer enclosure dimensions
custom.value:
356 H x 449 W x 950 D mm; CSE-GP807TS-R000NP. Catalog placement is 8U; dimensions do not alter rack geometry.
Source: https://www.supermicro.com/en/support/manuals/product/system/as-8126gs-nb3rt/Content/appendix/system-specifications-as-8126gs-nb3rt.htm

custom.name: Power input review required
custom.value:
Manufacturer module capacity tiers: 5900 W at 200–207.9 V; 6000 W at 208–219.9 V; 6300 W at 220–229.9 V; 6500 W at 230–238.9 V; 6600 W at 239–240 V. Verify the actual module label and installation. These are capacity references, not system AC demand.
Source: https://www.supermicro.com/en/products/system/gpu/8u/as-8126gs-nb3rt
